result.rationale: The diff adds `<%- end if %>` at app/views/embed/best.html.erb:6. ERB compiles tag contents directly into Ruby, so the template emits a bare `end if` with no condition, which is a Ruby syntax error; any render of the template (e.g., after EmbedController#best succeeds) would raise ActionView::Template::Error and 500. The fix `<%- end %>` matches the diff's intent (the `if` belongs to the `end if` closing the outer conditional... actually the `if %>` on line 5 pairs with line 6's `end`, and the stray trailing `if` after `end` is invalid). Verifiable directly from the shown view source.
